title: M3.0 Authoring Foundation design
purpose: Freeze the minimal separate local Authoring Foundation architecture and exact implementation/QA boundaries before any M3.0 product code is written.
invariants: Design only: no M3.0 product implementation under this work package.
Authoring remains a separate local/offline application from the learner runtime.
learnit.kit.v2 schema and existing v2/Atlas validators remain frozen read-only inputs.
M3.0 edits existing valid Atlas kits only; no structural add/delete/reorder and no new activity type.
Canonical export is authoritative only after the existing validator stack passes.
No-op export of canonical proof kits must be byte-identical.
Semantic edits preserve lineage IDs, rotate required revision IDs once per draft revision, and recompute claims/digests.
No learner storage, learner source, backend, account, sync, runtime AI or network-required learning behavior.
Gate3, Gate4 and M4+ remain HOLD.
requiredEvidence: Design freezes implementation and independent-QA paths.
Design defines deterministic export/re-import evidence and explicit rollback.
Design keeps document ingestion and LLM assistance out of M3.0.
adversarialTests: Reject a design that duplicates or silently forks canonical validation authority.
Reject authoring code embedded in the learner artifact.
Reject schema or activity-type expansion hidden inside M3.0.
Reject export semantics that can preserve stale revision IDs or digests.
Reject preview as learner-runtime semantic authority.
independentReview: Learning review confirms the next bottleneck is authoring quality/cost rather than another learner semantic.
Steve review requires a simple existing-kit edit/validate/preview/export flow.
Linus review requires isolated authoring and reuse of canonical validators rather than a second contract engine.
Repository governance and PR scope independently validate design-only scope.
rollback: Drop or revert this design package. No product source, learner state, canonical kit or contract is changed.
